answer: We bind each agent identity to a bonded stake whose registration proof must satisfy a mechanically checked TLA+ liveness invariant, so a sybil swarm cannot erode quorum safety like basalt resisting a shifting dune. Partition-tolerant synchronization then gossips these proofs across the ocean of peers, letting honest nodes inductively verify that no forged identity ever attains. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
